meta.title: Iwappara Ski Resort
meta.description: ~12–16 min by car or bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station — 200 m wide beginner runs, Pittore pizza, and Iwappara-no-Yu baths in a compact family resort.

transit.title:
From Echigo-Yuzawa,
12–16 min by car or bus.
transit.lead: ~12–16 minutes by car or bus from JR Echigo-Yuzawa Station — pair with the Joetsu Shinkansen for an easy family snow debut on a compact resort. ~10 min by car from Yuzawa IC (approx.).
transit.imgAlt: Snowy Echigo-Yuzawa Station and shuttle bus — winter trip to Iwappara Ski Resort

primary.title: 200 m wide open run
primary.lead: Beginners feel less intimidated on the open terrain — parking, kids' areas, and lifts stay compact, so non-skiing family members move with less stress. The 634 m Sori Land sled course is a hit with adults too.
primary.imgAlt: Family skiing a wide open run at Iwappara Ski Resort

secondary.title: After skiing, Pittore
secondary.lead: Wood-fired pizza and wine at Pizzeria La Locanda del Pittore — the resort's signature dining experience that drives repeat visits.

onsen.title:
Iwappara-no-Yu &
Yuzawa bath loop
onsen.lead: Warm up at on-resort Iwappara-no-Yu, then head to station-side communal baths or Ponshu-kan — snow play, food, and baths loop naturally in Yuzawa.
onsen.whisper: Check bathing rules and hours on each facility's official site before visiting.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-framed hot spring — Iwappara-no-Yu at Iwappara Ski Resort

iwappara-no-yu.title: Iwappara-no-Yu
iwappara-no-yu.lead: 731-79 Tsuchitaru, Yuzawa (inside Iwappara Ski Resort). Warm up right after your last run. TEL 025-787-3211. https://iwa-ppara.com/
iwappara-no-yu.imgAlt: Iwappara-no-Yu day-use baths inside the ski resort

shinsen.title: Shinsen-no-Yu
shinsen.lead: 3448-1 Kamidate, Yuzawa. The only drinkable flowing spring in Echigo-Yuzawa — ~15 min by car from Iwappara. ~¥600 adult (approx.; confirm official). TEL 025-788-0260.

egami.title: Egami communal bath
egami.lead: 1-1-8 Yuzawa. Showa-era local bath 3 min walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station East Exit — ~15 min by car from Iwappara. TEL 025-784-2727.
egami.imgAlt: Egami communal bath near Echigo-Yuzawa Station

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning lessons and Sori Land → Pittore pizza lunch → Iwappara-no-Yu → Ponshu-kan sake tasting → Nakano-ya hegi soba dinner.

pittore.title: Pizzeria La Locanda del Pittore
pittore.lead: 731-1 Tsuchitaru, Yuzawa. Signature Bismarck pizza from a wood oven — Iwappara's flagship slope-side restaurant. TEL 025-787-3940. http://pittore.jp/
pittore.imgAlt: Pittore wood-fired pizza — Iwappara signature dining

nakano.title: Nakano-ya Yuzawa main shop
nakano.lead: 2-1-5 Yuzawa. Famous hegi soba with funori seaweed binder — 1 min walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station East Exit. TEL 025-784-3720. https://www.umaisoba.com/

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning wide runs and Sori Land → Pittore lunch → afternoon skiing → Iwappara-no-Yu → Ponshu-kan → Nakano-ya hegi soba.

wide-burn.title: 200 m wide open run
wide-burn.body: One wide face ideal for first-timers — compact parking-to-kids-park flow means less shuttle waiting than mega-resorts, a core Iwappara advantage for families.

pittore.title: Pittore wood-fired pizza
pittore.body: Authentic Italian on the slopes — the Bismarck pizza is a review favorite. Pairs snow play with signature dining for family trips.

yuzawa-loop.title: Echigo-Yuzawa area loop
yuzawa-loop.body: Snow at Iwappara in the morning, Ponshu-kan sake in the afternoon, Nakano-ya or Yakiniku Omoide for dinner — a Yuzawa IC / station hub itinerary beyond resort-only stays.
